_comment: Epic 1 (Measurement Validation Gate) — S2-group CPU HIGH FREQUENCY app on Pixel 9 over WiFi-ADB. APK from https://github.com/S2-group/android-apps-benchmark 'APKs/Cpu High Frequency/e.www.cpufactorialtest.apk'. MainActivity runs a Handler.postDelayed loop computing BigInteger.factorial(7858) every 1000 ms (High = 1s interval). Pairs with validation_s2_baseline_pixel9_wifi.json. No usb_handler block — hub adapter is dead, Pixel 9 is on WiFi-ADB only. Run command (from android-runner/ with venv active): python3 . examples/batterymanager/validation_s2_cpu_high_pixel9_wifi.json
